intro: Morocco has about 37 million people of Arab and Amazigh heritage.

chapters.title: People and languages
text: Arabic and Tamazight are official languages, and French is widely used in business. Most people are Sunni Muslim, and there is a small historic Jewish community.
Millions of Moroccans live in France, Spain, Belgium and the Netherlands.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Casablanca is the biggest city; Rabat is the capital.
